add_expense:
def add_expense(state, amount, category, note \\ :no_note) do
  cond do
    not is_number(amount) -> raise("amount must be a positive number")
    amount <= 0 -> raise("amount must be a positive number")
    not is_binary(category) -> raise("category is required")
    category == "" -> raise("category is required")
    note == nil -> raise("breaks expenses-shape")
    note != :no_note and not is_binary(note) -> raise("note must be a string")
    true ->
      expenses = Map.get(state, "expenses", [])
      expense =
        if note == :no_note do
          %{"amount" => amount, "category" => category}
        else
          %{"amount" => amount, "category" => category, "note" => note}
        end
      new_expenses = expenses ++ [expense]
      {length(new_expenses), Map.put(state, "expenses", new_expenses)}
  end
end
by_category:
def by_category(state) do
  state
  |> Map.get("expenses", [])
  |> Enum.group_by(fn e -> e["category"] end, fn e -> round(e["amount"] * 100) end)
  |> Enum.map(fn {cat, cents} -> {cat, Enum.sum(cents) / 100} end)
  |> Enum.into(%{})
end
over_budget:
def over_budget(state) do
  state
  |> Map.get("budgets", %{})
  |> Enum.filter(fn {cat, amount} -> spent_cents(state, cat) > round(amount * 100) end)
  |> Enum.map(fn {cat, _amount} -> cat end)
  |> Enum.sort()
end
set_budget:
def set_budget(state, category, amount) do
  cond do
    not is_binary(category) -> raise("category is required")
    not is_number(amount) -> raise("budget must be a non-negative number")
    amount < 0 -> raise("budget must be a non-negative number")
    true ->
      budgets = Map.put(Map.get(state, "budgets", %{}), category, amount)
      {amount, Map.put(state, "budgets", budgets)}
  end
end
spent_cents:
defp spent_cents(state, category) do
  state
  |> Map.get("expenses", [])
  |> Enum.filter(fn e -> e["category"] == category end)
  |> Enum.reduce(0, fn e, acc -> acc + round(e["amount"] * 100) end)
end
top_category:
def top_category(state) do
  case by_category(state) do
    m when map_size(m) == 0 ->
      nil
    m ->
      m
      |> Enum.sort_by(fn {cat, amount} -> {-amount, cat} end)
      |> hd()
      |> elem(0)
  end
end
total:
def total(state) do
  cents = state |> Map.get("expenses", []) |> Enum.reduce(0, fn e, acc -> acc + round(e["amount"] * 100) end)
  cents / 100
end
